subject: Re: Vectorlytics observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards
messages:
From: Sam Torres <storres@vectorlytics.com>

Cc: procurement@vectorlytics.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — initial ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Vectorlytics is evaluating Redwood for inference and a key blocker for our procurement team is observability. Two specific asks:

- Retention: we currently need 12 months of traces and structured logs for audit; can you outline tiered pricing for 90/365/540 day retention?
- Tracing: per-span sampling, and backfill pricing if we need to import historical traces.
- Advanced dashboards: how are custom dashboards priced (per seat, per org, or as an add-on SKU)?

Procurement attached our RFP excerpt (Vectorlytics_RFP_202705.pdf). We're sensitive to first-year TCO; if there's a standard discounting or credit structure for committed spend, please share.

Would you be able to provide a ballpark quote and a proposed packaging option by Wednesday?

Best,
Sam Torres
VP of Platform
Vectorlytics

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700

Hi Sam — thanks for sending the RFP excerpt and the clear list. Quick answers up front, then I'll follow with a proposal: 

- Retention tiers: we support 90 / 365 / 540 day tiers. Pricing is usage + storage slab; I attached our SKU sheet (Observability_Addons_SKU_v3.xlsx) for line-item rates.
- Tracing/backfill: backfill billed as a one-time ingestion fee based on compressed bytes; ongoing tracing is charged on spans ingested + trace storage.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are an add-on SKU; includes unlimited dashboards for the org tier or per-seat for small teams.

We do have a common commercial concession pattern for new enterprise customers: a first-year percentage discount combined with a consumption credit that phases down in year two. If you can share a 12-month estimated ingestion profile (tokens/spans/GB retained) we can model a firm quote.

I'm looping Marcus (AE) to propose a commercial structure. We'll aim to get a draft quote by Wednesday EOD PT.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Mina — quick internal note before we send external pricing:

- Vectorlytics looks mid-market but trending enterprise; probable initial commit ~$200k ARR for inference.
- Recommendation: offer 20% off list for observability add-ons in year one with a $25k consumption credit applied to trace retention (they called out 12 months).
- Make the credit contingent on a 12-month commitment to Dedicated or Hosted with a min $300k ARR.
- For dashboards, consider offering org-tier dashboards at a flat $10k setup credit (one-time) to remove friction for executive visibility.

Risks: standard legal will push back on trial credits; finance needs to be looped for final pricing approval.

If Mina is comfortable, I'll approve and we can include the exact numbers in the quote doc.

-Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — attaching a short proposal and a draft quote that maps to the RFP asks. Key points: 

1) Retention tiers (list): 90d / 365d / 540d. Suggested default = 365d for compliance customers.
2) Pricing: storage billed per GB-month; traces billed per million spans with a separate ingestion/backfill line item.
3) Intro concession: 20% off observability add-on list prices for 12 months + a $25k consumption credit applied to trace retention ingestion if Vectorlytics signs a 12-month commitment to Redwood Hosted (min $300k ARR).
4) Dashboard offer: one-time $10k setup credit applied to advanced dashboard onboarding (waived for org-tier purchase).

I've attached: Vectorlytics_Proposed_Quote_20270505.pdf and the SKU spreadsheet. If that structure works, procurement can send a PO and we'll issue a formal SOW.

Requested next step: Can procurement confirm an approximate monthly spans/GB ingestion number (even a range) so I can finalize the credit math?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Hi — quick clarifications: 

1) Credits: the $25k consumption credit is applied against invoices (not a cash refund) and will be consumed first against trace ingestion charges. It is not refundable and expires at the end of the first contract year.

2) Retention surcharge: temporary extension beyond the committed retention (e.g., 365d -> 720d for an audit window up to 90 days) is accommodated as a short-term surcharge; rate = 1.5x the incremental GB-month rate for the extended period. Longer-term changes require a contract amendment.

3) Dashboard credit: happy to structure the $10k onboarding credit as a 12-month amortized monthly credit ($833/month) if that aligns better with your budgeting — we can reflect that in the redlineable SOW.

I'll upload the redlineable SOW and the quote to the Drive link and share once ready (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b-obs-quote-vec). If procurement gives a quick thumbs to the three bullets above I can circulate the PO instructions and the SOW.

Best,
